title: Hook Type Decoupling and Translation
body: Implement SDK-independent hook types with a translation layer to decouple hook interfaces from the underlying Gemini SDK, ensuring hooks remain stable across SDK updates.

linked_prs.title: feat(hooks): Hook Type Decoupling and Translation
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

Creates stable hook API types (LLMRequest, LLMResponse, HookToolConfig) and implements HookTranslatorGenAIv1 class for transparent bidirectional translation between SDK and hook formats.
[Part of full hook system implementation here](https://github.com/Edilmo/gemini-cli/pull/7/files)

## Dive Deeper

This addresses the critical requirement for SDK independence. The translation layer ensures that hooks work with stable interfaces regardless of changes to the @google/genai SDK. The HookTranslatorGenAIv1 class handles complex conversions between GenerateContentParameters/Response and the simplified hook formats. This enables hooks to use clean, predictable interfaces while the core handles SDK evolution transparently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

- Run translation tests: `npm test packages/core/src/hooks/hookTranslator.test.ts`
- Verify bidirectional conversion: SDK → Hook → SDK produces equivalent results
- Test edge cases: empty configs, missing fields, malformed data
- Validate type safety: ensure no `any` types are used in public interfaces
